data.name: DisablePowerThrottlingName
data.value: Disable global Power Throttling

data.name: DisablePowerThrottlingDescription
data.value: Turns off Windows Power Throttling for background applications. Separate from the power plan's minimum CPU state; does not disable thermal protection. Optional, not recommended automatically: may increase power consumption and temperatures, with no guaranteed gaming benefit. Restart required. Restore returns the original registry value.

data.name: DisableHibernationName
data.value: Disable hibernation

data.name: DisableHibernationDescription
data.value: Uses powercfg to remove the hibernation file and reclaim disk space, not increase FPS. Also makes Fast Startup and hybrid sleep unavailable. Saves the original hibernation type and size for restoration. Administrator rights required. Changes persist after closing the portable app: keep its Data folder to retain undo information.

data.name: HibernationUnavailable
data.value: Hibernation is already disabled without a TweakHub backup, or its original type/size cannot be read safely. Use Windows power settings; no guessed configuration will be written.

data.name: ServicesTitle
data.value: Optional services

data.name: ServicesDescription
data.value: Change only services whose features you do not use. Manual allows on-demand/triggered starts; Disabled prevents them. Nothing is selected or changed automatically. SysMain and telemetry use their existing tweaks; error reporting is retained for diagnostics. No generic FPS promises.

data.name: ServicesNoStop
data.value: Startup configuration only: running services are not stopped, dependencies and triggers are preserved. Effects may require restarting Windows. Keep this copy's Data folder to restore the original configuration.

data.name: ServiceConfirm
ServiceFailed
data.value: The service configuration could not be verified. No backup was discarded. Refresh, then restore the original configuration if necessary.

data.name: ServiceManagedElsewhere
data.value: This service has a backup in another TweakHub section. Restore it from that section first to avoid conflicting backups.

data.name: ServiceSysMain
data.value: App preloading and caching. An SSD does not make this service useless. Leave enabled unless diagnosing a specific issue; its optional tweak already exists in Registry tweaks.

data.name: ServiceMapsBroker
data.value: Downloaded/offline maps. Consider changing only if you do not use them. A stopped service already consumes no CPU for running work.

data.name: ServiceRetailDemo
data.value: Retail demonstration mode for display PCs. Usually unnecessary on a personal PC; do not change on a retail demonstration machine.

data.name: ServiceDiagTrack
data.value: Connected user experiences and telemetry. Already covered by the telemetry tweak; changing it can reduce diagnostic data. No duplicate control here.

data.name: Servicedmwappushservice
data.value: Device-management WAP push routing, not simply telemetry. Leave enabled on organization/MDM-managed devices. Disabling may interrupt management messages.

data.name: ServiceWbioSrvc
data.value: Windows biometrics. Do not disable if you use fingerprint or facial recognition; those sign-in features may stop working.

data.name: ServiceWerSvc
data.value: Windows Error Reporting supports crash diagnostics. Retained, not offered as a performance tweak.

data.name: ServicePcaSvc
data.value: Program Compatibility Assistant. May help older applications and installers; disabling can remove compatibility assistance.

Can delete files/apps and change Windows; TweakHub cannot undo all its actions. Allow hours and make your own backup first.

data.name: TronDownloadConfirm
data.value: Download the complete Tron self-extracting package from bmrf.org (hundreds of MB) into this copy's Data/Tools/Tron folder? Size and SHA-256 are checked against the publisher's HTTPS manifest. This is an integrity check, not independent certification. No downloaded code runs in this step.

data.name: TronExtractConfirm
data.value: This runs the verified publisher self-extractor without requesting additional elevation (it inherits TweakHub's current privileges). An older extracted copy will be replaced; its local changes will be lost. The package and extracted files are checked before launch. Tron cleanup itself is not started in this step.

data.name: TronRunConfirm

Have you backed up your files and rebooted to finish pending Windows updates? Tron can remove software/files, change settings and run for hours; interruption can leave Windows partially modified. Compatibility with your build is not guaranteed: do not override Tron's OS checks.
Launch elevated in a visible console with its own disclaimer. Arguments: -p -spr -m -sor -se -scs preserve power settings, pagefile configuration, default apps, OneDrive and event logs, and skip custom scripts. Other cleanup/repair operations still run. data.name: AffinityTitle
data.value: Affinity

data.name: AffinityDescription
data.value: Assign PCI device interrupts to logical CPUs, not application processes. USB/HID devices normally share their host controller's interrupts. Same-core CPU labels identify SMT siblings. Drivers may ignore the policy; wrong settings can hurt latency or stability. Restart required, no automatic optimization.

data.name: AutomaticAffinity
data.value: Windows automatic placement

data.name: AffinityHint
data.value: Select one or more logical CPUs, or choose Windows automatic placement. Physical-core labels group SMT siblings. Restore original affects affinity only, not MSI or priority.

data.name: AffinityUnsupported
data.value: Manual affinity is unavailable: topology could not be read or this PC uses multiple processor groups. No 64-bit mask is guessed or truncated. Automatic placement and restoring an existing backup remain available.

data.name: AffinitySelectionRequired
data.value: Select at least one supported CPU or use Windows automatic placement.

data.name: NoAutoSleepName
data.value: Never sleep automatically when plugged in

data.name: NoAutoSleepDescription
data.value: Sets the Windows power policies (Group Policy → Power Management) so that, when plugged in, the PC never goes to sleep or hibernates on its own, hybrid sleep is off, disks never spin down and Energy Saver never turns on automatically or stays forced on. Applies to every power plan; nothing changes on battery. You can still put the PC to sleep manually. The Group Policy editor keeps showing "Not configured" because the values are written directly to the registry. Restore puts back the original values. Restart required.

data.name: DisableSleepName
data.value: Turn off sleep completely when plugged in

data.name: DisableSleepDescription
data.value: When plugged in, Windows no longer allows standby (S1–S3), the sleep key does nothing and Sleep is hidden from the Start power menu. Use it only if you never put this PC to sleep. Optional, not recommended automatically. PCs with Modern Standby do not use S1–S3 and keep their own sleep. Restore puts back the original values. Restart required.

data.name: TronBlockedByAntivirus
data.value: Microsoft Defender (or your antivirus) blocked the Tron package as potentially unwanted software and removed it. TweakHub never adds antivirus exclusions. If you trust Tron, add exclusions yourself for this copy's Data\Tools\Tron folder and for C:\ProgramData\TweakHub-Tron-*, then try again.
